list: The official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 18 Nov 2026 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden).
method: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in this entry's own words; where a step comes from a published guide, that guide is named beside it with its date. Where the game is a day old and a detail is still unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of guessing.
sourcesUsed: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
PowerPyx GTA 6 trophy guide & roadmap, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: The crown of the list: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no trick to it beyond finishing everything else. Treat A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, as the real final hurdle — it is the longest single demand in the game, and published roadmaps put the whole platinum at around 200 hours. Follow the six stages of this guide in order, keep the one possibly missable meditation in mind in Chapter 1, and the platinum lands on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the opening missions of Chapter 1 — it cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main story. Just play through the opening as the game directs you and it pops on completion. No special approach is needed: there are no mission medals or ratings to chase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1, and it arrives once you have started the first mission of Chapter 2 — so if it has not popped the instant the chapter ends, keep playing a few minutes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house: it is the one thing in the game reported as possibly missable (see Positive Mental Attitude). The chapter trophy itself cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and the trophy follows as Chapter 3 begins. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: both characters become playable together, which matters for the partner trophies and for the final meditation spot. Nothing here can be missed — play the story at your own pace.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3; it lands after the first couple of missions of Chapter 4, so a short delay is normal. Chapter 3 is a busy one for side content — Andy's, Tyrone's and Randy's quest lines all open here, and the jewelry jobs unlock tools you will want later. The trophy itself is unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and this one is yours. By now most of the game's systems are open — bank vaults, gang operations and the full map — so it is a good moment to glance at the tracker and see which side trophies are already close. Like every chapter trophy, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Play the story to its end and this gold trophy pops with the final mission. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing else on the list is locked behind the ending — the clean-up stages of this guide all assume you have finished the story first. There is no mission replay and no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so finish it however you like.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed, since the mission is mandatory. If you are tracking your story progress, this is one of the early Chapter 2 beats.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and the trophy is yours. It is a main-story mission, so it cannot be missed and needs no special preparation. Expect a big set piece — heists are where the game shows off.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. Play the mission through to its end; it cannot be missed. No particular loadout or approach is required for the trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission, and the trophy pops. It is part of the main story, so it is unmissable — just keep following the story missions in order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 — a story mission at the airport — and the trophy is yours. It cannot be missed. Note the airport itself matters for a different trophy later: Catch Me If You Can asks you to leave VCIA in an unscheduled way, so you will be back.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, the last chapter, and the trophy pops. It is a mandatory story mission and cannot be missed. After this the final mission is close — see You Gotta Know When to Get Off.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the longest single job in the game. The 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion) appears after the story, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It does not ask for literally everything: full marks are needed on robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks, while the rest only needs a share — for example 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges and 200 of 277 vehicle scans. Budget around 100 hours for this stage alone.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, in any mix: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to build the number, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy — the Progress menu tracks your count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Most of these come naturally while chasing other trophies, and the Progress menu shows which are left. A single taste of each is enough — nothing needs to be mastered.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so this is worth doing before that trophy. Take your time with each challenge's scoring — gold is a threshold, not a race.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it pays to finish each location while you are there rather than coming back. Learn the drone's handling on the first location before chasing wins.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer — repeating a race you have already won does not count. Pick the race types you are comfortable with first, then work through the rest. A win also counts toward Master of None if you have not tried racing yet.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: You meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; afterwards he texts you and marks a fishing spot. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this pairs well with that trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them are playable on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade cabinets around Leonida, so pick whichever you enjoy most. Finishing one also ticks off the arcade activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — the last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush, but they are easy to miss if you never check Lucia's phone.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks: dive at the marked chests and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish the line then — the trophy is not missable. Track progress under Kenton's Treasures in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and the fifth awards the trophy. They stay available after the story. Head to the mud club whenever you are in Kelly County and work through them in order.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Not every stranger counts — published guides confirm some (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete) and rule out the character quest lines, while the rest of the qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the community, so watch your trophy progress counter. None of them are needed for 100% and all stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Which strands qualify beyond the four named is still being confirmed by guide sites.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner: deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list, and check hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Cars in better condition pay more, so drive carefully on the way in.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked around Vice City; once enough are gone, his last job awards the trophy. It is a straightforward demolition run — clear the marked labs and the finale unlocks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot until the counter reaches 18: there are 10 locations, and meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice at most spots. The last spot only appears after the others, and needs both characters, which is possible from Chapter 2. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy on the list with that warning: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony at Jason's house and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and guides disagree on whether the trophy needs it (it raises the counter but is not marked as a spot), so do it to be safe. Note the dispute: the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this cannot cost you A Long Road either way.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy is unconfirmed — PowerPyx and GTABase both say so. Do it to be safe.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet by published guides, and the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway — so work through the decks and it should come.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Which animal triggers the trophy is not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the three nearest completion first. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick them up as you travel rather than hunting them in one run.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app — any 100 count, drawn from landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags across the state. Open the app whenever you pass somewhere new and the total climbs on its own. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and that checklist item finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; the Progress menu marks finished ones. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way — check the list late in your run and pick off the easiest stragglers.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner, build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks naturally during Maximum Withdrawal; a long tunnel or remote stretch of road shakes off pursuers well.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted — do not lose the heat between shops. Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items, and pick three shops close together so the run is quick. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them, just scan them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic to build the number fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so keep scanning after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus, which only lasts a few seconds — so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well as targets. Raising your Focus level at shooting ranges first makes the window more forgiving.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about a kilometre away from the airport. The gates at the far end of the terminal are the easiest to reach: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base — then take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out; the tank itself is the easy part once you are rolling.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm — find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Any jewelry store works; move slowly and check for staff before each step.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission about where the money is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open — the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the eight vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all eight, so keep going.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one too, as long as you then escape the heat zone — so it may pop during Maximum Withdrawal. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. Either route needs a clean escape, so plan your exit before you start.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch, then mopping up the corners on foot or by car. It pairs naturally with the collectible hunts — exploration, card sets and WAiNK scans all reward the same wandering.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation from each of the 9 gangs — the Progress menu keeps count per gang. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy is just the first pass: work through the marked operations and the gangs fill in one by one.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps are not confirmed yet by published guides — the game is a day old — so look for a bar or seating spot with an ocean view along the beach and try the drink prompt there. This guide will not invent a location: check back once guide sites pin it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Exact steps not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom — a nod to the series' classic showroom smash. The exact showroom and steps are not confirmed yet by published guides, so do not waste time hunting blindly: the detail is expected to surface quickly as players map the city. This entry marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Exact steps not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by a Chapter 2 mission. Take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs) — and the trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so try to get them together.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out at fitness clubs with your partner along — training one trains the other too — and after the story you can also train at home. Check both characters' Strength in the pause menu; the trophy pops when the second one maxes out.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — most players get it without trying, just by playing. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings so you can watch the count climb. One warning from published guides: do not push towards the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — but what, exactly, is not confirmed yet by published guides. It may be tied to a specific retry moment in the game, and the community is still narrowing it down. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a step; check the sources named here for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Exact trigger not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — the description reads like a reaction to something unexpected. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet by published guides, so this guide will not point you at a guessed location. Keep exploring and check the cited guides as the community pins it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Exact trigger not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact conditions are not confirmed yet by published guides, so the safest reading is: while driving, use a melee attack to knock down a pedestrian. This guide marks it unconfirmed until a guide site confirms the details.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
trophies.unconfirmed: Exact conditions not yet confirmed by published guides.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 mission gets you the Dye Pack Jammer; after that, rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — one Vice City fence pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies you do for 100% completion get you there without extra grinding.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, and you will spend much of it naturally on gear for other trophies. If you are close late in the game, a shopping spree on mods closes the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 — about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Garage space also matters for On the Spot, so buy early if you can afford it.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them — at first he only takes cars without trackers, and from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Official list via Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026
